newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - IVORY COAST - AUG 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - IVORY COAST - AUG 14.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Newspaper denounces sharp practices of some estate agents, taking advantage of Abidjan's housing crisis, and calls on authorities to tighten regulations in sector.
- President of new business arbitration court calls the tribunal "a partial privatisation" of the justice system and says it will give confidence to investors.
- A union of small rubber producers plans to halt production for whole of September in protest at low prices.
